evidence.quote:

Weakness: Fire, Harm

subject: Lich
text: In the initial round against Lich, having the Red or Black Mage cast Fast on the strongest attacker and the White Mage cast Aice counters Lich's early Ice2 spell.

evidence.quote: Also in that initial round, have the Red and Black Mage cast Fast on your strongest character, and with any luck they'll get the spell before attacking. I also have my White Mage use the Aice spell, since as far as I've noticed Lich almost always uses Ice2 the first round.

subject: Lich
text: Offensive magic against Lich includes the Black Mage casting Fir3 and the White Mage casting Hrm3.

evidence.quote: Black Mage uses Fir3 on Lich and the fighters (with Fast on them I would hope) attack... the White Mage should cast Hrm3.

subject: Earth Crystal
text: Stepping on the panel behind Lich restores the power of Earth to the Orb and exits the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote: Once Lich is defeated, step on the panel behind him, and you'll return the power of the Earth to one of your Orbs, (See the Menu screen and you'll notice one of the orbs is lit up again) plus you'll get a free exit from the Earth Cave.

subject: Canoe

evidence.quote:
Key Item: Canoe*
